Chat.title: Chat
Chat.description: A conversational thread owned by a specific authenticated user.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this conversation.

saved.description: Whether the conversation is bookmarked/saved by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the conversation was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the conversation was last updated.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual message within a Chat thread.

chatId.description: ID of the parent Chat document.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this message and parent chat.

content.description: Text and poetic markdown content of the message.

feedback.description: User rating feedback on an assistant message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was last modified.

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Subcollection of messages belonging to a specific conversation.
